name: Ask-pdf
description: A full-stack RAG chatbot that lets users chat with uploaded PDFs - LangChain, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Pinecone vector search with real-time response streaming.

name: Anonytalks
description: A self-hosted social platform for anonymous, direct media sharing via unique shareable links, with AWS S3 uploads and NextAuth (Google OAuth + password).

name: Xtract
description: A full-stack bank-statement PDF text extractor that lets users upload statements and view the extracted data in a structured table - AWS Textract for OCR, SNS pub/sub to signal extraction completion, Gemini 2.5 Flash to structure the raw text, and TanStack Table for tabular display.
